title: Claude Haiku 3 retired and the default replacement costs four times as much
detail: Haiku 3 ran at $0.25 input and $1.25 output per million tokens. The migration path is Haiku 4.5 at $1 and $5, or Haiku 3.5 at $0.80 and $4 where cost matters more than capability. Claude Sonnet 3.7 is deprecated as well.
impact: A removal that is really a price rise. High-volume classification or extraction built on Haiku 3 economics gets four times more expensive on the default path. Price Haiku 3.5 before defaulting to 4.5.
